name: enam_get_mandi_prices
description: Fetches current commodity prices for a specific mandi. Returns modal, minimum, and maximum prices with quality grades. PUBLIC tool — no auth required. Does NOT execute buy/sell transactions. Fails if commodity or mandi is unsupported, or no price data is available. Prices may be delayed.

commodity.description: Standardized commodity name (e.g., paddy, wheat, cotton).

name: enam_search_mandis
description: Searches for mandis by location (state/district). Returns mandi names, codes, and supported commodities. PUBLIC tool. Does NOT return prices — use enam_get_mandi_prices. Fails if location is invalid or no mandis found. May return multiple mandis with same name (ambiguity).

name: enam_compare_prices
description: Compares prices of a commodity across multiple mandis to help identify best selling opportunity. PUBLIC tool. Does NOT execute transactions. Fails if commodity is unsupported or fewer than 2 mandis have data. Results may contain partial data if some mandis haven't updated.

name: enam_get_price_trends
description: Retrieves historical price trends for a commodity at a mandi over a specified time range. Returns price data for analysis. PUBLIC tool. Does NOT predict future prices. Historical data limited to available records. Fails if commodity, mandi, or time range is invalid.

name: enam_get_best_price
description: Identifies the mandi offering the best (highest) price for a commodity within a state or district. Decision support tool. PUBLIC. Does NOT guarantee prices at arrival time. Fails if commodity is unsupported or no data available. Stale prices may affect accuracy.

name: enam_get_arrival_data
description: Retrieves arrival quantities and demand trends for a commodity at a mandi. PUBLIC tool. Does NOT show prices — use enam_get_mandi_prices. Fails if mandi or commodity is unsupported.

name: enam_get_mandi_details
description: Returns details of a specific mandi including address, timings, supported commodities, and contact info. PUBLIC tool. Does NOT return prices. Fails if mandi_id or name is invalid.

name: enam_filter_prices
description: Filters commodity prices by multiple criteria: quality grade, price type, date range. PUBLIC tool. Does NOT compare across mandis — use enam_compare_prices. Fails if filters produce no results or are invalid.

name: enam_resolve_mandi_ambiguity
description: Resolves ambiguous mandi names matching multiple locations. Returns disambiguated list with state/district context. PUBLIC tool. Does NOT return prices. Fails if name matches no mandis.

name: enam_set_preferences
description: Sets user preferences for commodity and mandi notifications. Requires session_token. Does NOT fetch prices. Fails if session is invalid or preferences are malformed.

session_token.description: Token returned after optional authentication. Required for preference and grievance tools.

name: enam_raise_grievance
description: Raises a grievance about eNAM data. Valid categories: 'incorrect_price', 'missing_mandi_data', 'delayed_update', 'wrong_location', 'commodity_not_found'. Requires session_token. Fails if category is invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after optional authentication. Required for preference and grievance tools.

name: enam_track_grievance_status
description: Tracks eNAM grievance status. Requires session_token. Fails if grievance_id is invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after optional authentication. Required for preference and grievance tools.
